output.text: {"notes":["The requested readout is at absolute time 2.0 s in the world frame: load position in metres, swing angle in radians, angular velocity in rad/s, and a dimensionless boundary-crossed boolean.","The world frame is right-handed with +x forward, +y left, and +z up; positive swing angle displaces the load toward +x.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.414, 0.614) s: +0.4118577781183268 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the negative of that acceleration for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","The boundary flag means the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m with 0.005 m hysteresis after the observation cutoff."]}
